subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having numbers 1 to 6 represented as dots. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '2'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/369f73f1abbc5318c398ba105eff7ff30de38e87af4fcf3a9e9cf9adac232961.png]
solution:
As per the given positions of dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7234596fdf93051c5b59af0eb1156ac0e096fc9d906702ec895d44ecb069369.png] 

Here, (4) and (3) are common, which means (2) is opposite to the (1).

Here, the opposite face of the face showing (2) is the face showing (1).

Hence, the correct answer is "1".
